title: Khoon me tar qamar hai Muslim ke
body:
Khoon me tar qamar hai Muslim ke
Zere Qanjar pisar hai Muslim ke
<<DIVIDER>>
Uth gaya sar se baap ka saaya
Darbadar ab pisar hai Muslim ke
<<DIVIDER>>
Inka pursa nehaal koi nahi
ye jo noore nazar hai Muslim ke
<<DIVIDER>>
gardano se lahu ubalta hai
qoon me tar pisar hai muslim ke
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar dikhaakar ye kehta hai zalim
dono laqte jigar hai muslim ke
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe darya me beh gaye jinke
Haaye dono pisar hai muslim ke
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye zafar peeto sar ke dono laal
Qoon me tar batar hai muslim ke
